scientific.integrity: The exact formulas are derived from a closed finite-dimensional moment system and an analytic sign argument. The accompanying checker is finite corroboration and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific.limitations: The result is proved for a constant-rate pure-birth Yule process begun from one lineage, with total pendant length defined as the sum of extant lineage ages. It does not assert the corresponding result under fixed-tip conditioning or under extinction.

title: Tip-count adjustment reverses cherry–pendant-length covariance in the Yule process
